title: Room-temperature lattice thermal conductivity
action: From the computed thermal conductivity spectrum, extract the total thermal conductivity at 300 K for RhSi and RhSn and write as a CSV file.
description: The room-temperature thermal conductivity is the main headline quantity for the pure compounds.
output_schema: Columns: Material (string, 'RhSi' or 'RhSn'), Kappa_300K (float, W/(m·K)). Two rows.

title: Temperature-dependent thermal conductivity extraction
action: From the raw thermal conductivity data, extract values at temperatures from 100 K to 1000 K in increments of no more than 100 K for both RhSi and RhSn. Write a CSV file with columns Temperature_K, Kappa_RhSi, Kappa_RhSn.
description: The temperature dependence verifies the decreasing trend and provides additional checkpoints.
output_schema: Columns: Temperature_K (float), Kappa_RhSi (float, W/(m·K)), Kappa_RhSn (float, W/(m·K)). Rows for temperatures from 100 K to 1000 K, step ≤ 100 K.
